stem.text: Some antibiotics work by binding to ribosomes.
Which statement explains why these antibiotics kill bacteria cells but do not kill most human cells?

A.text: mRNA in bacteria is formed in the cytoplasm from naked DNA.

B.text: The antibiotics cannot pass through human cell membranes.

C.text: The codes used for amino acids in bacteria are different from those used by humans.

D.text: The ribosomes of bacteria have a different structure from those of humans.
